claims.claim: The Konica Minolta Bizhub Pro C754e is a large, full colour, laser multifunctional printer.
claims.evidence: The witness identified the machine as a Konica Minolta bizhub PRO C754e with a scanner and four paper trays.
The witness explicitly read 'bizhub PRO C754e' from the front panel of the machine.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or has a faulty mainboard.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine booting up to the home screen.

risks.risk: The imaging drums or fuser may be damaged or at end-of-life.
risks.proof: A photo of a printed 'Consumables Status' report or a CMYK test pattern.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring immediate replacement of all drums and fuser unit

risks.risk: The machine may have an extremely high page count (meter reading).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Meter Count' screen showing total prints.
risks.if_unproven: as a high-mileage unit near its maximum service life

risks.risk: The scanner glass or ADF rollers may be scratched or worn.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the scanner glass and a video of the ADF feeding paper.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and reaching the ready state.
Photo of a 'Test Print' or 'Demo Page' printed by the machine.
Photo of the 'Consumables/Supply Life' status screen.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified the model as a C754e, despite the seller's conflicting claim. It can be priced as a non-functional unit for parts until proof of operation and print quality is provided.
